claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord (kind = "species_trait")
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no species_trait kind. The surface types only know spell, class_feature, and mastery. Every species trait requires this new top-level record type before any mechanics can be encoded.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Orc species entry: trait belongs to a species, not a class, and is acquired automatically at character creation — not through a class level.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_reactive_trigger mechanics family for species traits
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Relentless Endurance fires when an external combat event occurs (reduction to 0 HP). This is not player-activated (no action cost), not a spell reaction (no spell infrastructure), and not a mastery on-hit rider. A new family is needed: a passive trigger that watches for a named event and responds once per resource charge.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: prevent_ko (or set_hp_floor)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The effect is not heal_hp (which adds dice to current HP). It sets HP to exactly 1, replacing a would-be reduction to 0. No v4 effect atom covers 'prevent knockout by setting HP to a fixed floor'. This is a distinct deterministic operation from any existing effect atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead" — not 'regain 1 HP', but 'land at 1 HP rather than 0'.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: damage_threshold_window (trigger: reduced_to_0_hp)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The reactive trigger that arms Relentless Endurance is a new window kind: fires when incoming damage would reduce the character to 0 HP. Not an on_hit_window (that tracks attacker hits, not defender HP floor). Not a post_action_window (which is post-creature-action, not post-damage). Needs a named window or event type for 'HP reduced to 0 or below'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright" — the trigger is a damage resolution outcome, not a creature action.
